sentence_1_it: Era un giullare e nulla di più. Non sentiva dolore; era un giullare e nulla di più.
sentence_1_en: He was a jester, and nothing more. He felt no pain; he was a jester, and nothing more.
sentence_2_it: La mia prima azione da Senatore è designarla come giullare ufficiale.
sentence_2_en: My first deed as Senator is designating you as the official jester.
sentence_3_it: Il principe e il giullare avevano molto in comune.
sentence_3_en: The prince and the jester had a lot in common.
